description.zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

- ExpireTimeStart
- ExpireTimeEnd
- PayType 
- ResourceARN
description.en:
The filter name. You can specify one or more filter names to query resources. Valid values:

- ExpireTimeStart

- ExpireTimeEnd

- PayType

- ResourceARN

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The query token. Set this to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call to retrieve the next page of results.
The ID of the service instance.

description.zh:
服务实例资源类型。可能的值：

- AliyunResource：阿里云资源。

- ContainerResource：容器组（Pod）资源。
description.en:
The type of the resource in the service instance. Valid values:

- AliyunResource: an Alibaba Cloud resource.

- ContainerResource: a pod.
The tag key of the resource.
The tag value of the resource.

title.zh: 查询服务实例包含的资源

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-instance-resources --next-token AAAAAc3HCuYhJi/wvpk4xOr0VLbAx7BkQzyYC+ONO+WudHGKEdB0uWSY7AGnM3qCgm/Ynge7zU6NWdbj0Tegyajyqyc= --max-results 20 --service-instance-id si-d8a0cc2a1ee04dce0000 --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-resource-type AliyunResource --filters '[{"Values":["arn:acs:ecs:0:0:instance/0"],"Name":"ResourceARN"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier ListServiceInstanceResources --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key1 --Filters.1.Name ResourceARN --NextToken 'AAAAAc3HCuYhJi/wvpk4xOr0VLbAx7BkQzyYC+ONO+WudHGKEdB0uWSY7AGnM3qCgm/Ynge7zU6NWdbj0Tegyajyqyc=' --ServiceInstanceId 'si-d8a0cc2a1ee04dce0000' --MaxResults 20 --Tag.1.Value value1 --Filters.1.Values.1 'arn:acs:ecs:0:0:instance/0' --ServiceInstanceResourceType AliyunResource --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
